name_ar: سياسة استخدام الحوسبة السحابية — المستأجر
en: Board-approved cloud usage policy; scope covering IaaS/PaaS/SaaS; shadow-IT prohibition clause; approved-cloud-service register; policy distribution and staff acknowledgement records.

name_ar: سجل مزودي الخدمات السحابية المعتمدين — المستأجر
en: Approved-CSP register with provider name, service description, classification of hosted data, NCA licensing status, and last risk-assessment date; onboarding checklist; decommission log.

name_ar: مصفوفة المسؤولية المشتركة — المزود والمستأجر
en: Signed shared-responsibility matrix (SRM) for each cloud deployment model in use (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS); SRM reviewed on contract renewal; evidence of gap analysis where CST controls supplement CSP defaults; SRM embedded in cloud onboarding checklist.

name_ar: استراتيجية الأمن السيبراني للسحابة وشهية المخاطر — المستأجر
en: Cloud security strategy document endorsed by CISO; risk appetite statement covering cloud services; cloud risk register with residual risk sign-off; annual review evidence.

name_en: Cloud Service Provider NCA Licensing Verification (CST)
name_ar: التحقق من ترخيص NCA لمزودي الخدمات السحابية — المستأجر
en: Evidence of NCA cloud licensing check for each CSP (NCA approved-CSP list cross-reference); annual re-verification records; escalation process for unlicensed CSP discovery.

name_ar: تقييم تصنيف البيانات في بيئة السحابة
en: Data classification assessment for each cloud workload; mapping to national classification requirements; restricted/sovereign data prohibition for public cloud without NCA approval; assessment updated on each new cloud migration project.

name_en: Data Residency Enforcement — KSA Sovereign Data
name_ar: تطبيق متطلبات الإقامة للبيانات السيادية السعودية
en: Cloud region configuration evidence (KSA region pinning); geo-restriction policy screenshots; storage account location audit; periodic cross-region replication review to confirm no out-of-kingdom copies of sovereign data.

name_ar: جرد البيانات السحابية ووضع علاماتها
en: Cloud resource tagging policy (classification, owner, environment, data-residency tags); tag compliance scan report (% tagged); untagged-resource remediation log; integration with CSPM for continuous tag enforcement.

name_en: MFA Enforcement for Cloud Console Access
name_ar: تطبيق المصادقة متعددة العوامل على وحدات التحكم السحابية
en: MFA policy configuration evidence for all cloud management accounts (AWS IAM policy, Azure Conditional Access, GCP Org Policy); MFA coverage report (% of accounts with MFA); break-glass account MFA exception log with compensating controls.

name_ar: تصميم أدوار الوصول وفق مبدأ الصلاحيات الدنيا
en: IAM policy review records showing no wildcard (*) permissions for production workloads; role definition documentation; unused permission removal log; quarterly access certification results.

name_ar: إدارة الحسابات المتميزة في السحابة — تكامل PAM
en: PAM tool integration with cloud management accounts evidence; just-in-time access provisioning configuration; privileged session recording for cloud console access; quarterly review of standing privileged cloud accounts.

name_ar: حوكمة حسابات الخدمة ومفاتيح واجهة برمجة التطبيقات
en: Service account inventory with purpose, owner, and last-rotation date; API key rotation schedule and evidence; prohibition of long-lived credentials in code repositories (secret scanning tool evidence); service account access review (quarterly).

name_en: Federated Identity & SSO for Cloud Access (CST)
name_ar: الهوية الموحدة وتسجيل الدخول الموحد للوصول السحابي — المستأجر
en: IdP federation configuration evidence (SAML/OIDC with corporate directory); local cloud-native accounts audit (minimised/eliminated); SSO coverage report; IdP health monitoring alerts.

name_ar: هندسة الشبكة الافتراضية الخاصة وتجزئتها
en: VPC/VNET architecture diagram showing subnet segmentation by environment (prod/non-prod) and workload tier; security group / network ACL baseline; peering and transit-gateway topology document; quarterly network architecture review.

name_en: Cloud Firewall & Security Group Rule Management
name_ar: إدارة جدار الحماية السحابي وقواعد مجموعات الأمان
en: Security group/firewall rule inventory; evidence of 0.0.0.0/0 inbound rule prohibition for sensitive ports; rule review cadence records (quarterly); IaC-enforced baseline configuration (Terraform/CloudFormation policy-as-code scan results).

name_ar: نشر جدار حماية تطبيقات الويب السحابي
en: WAF deployment evidence for public-facing cloud workloads; managed-rule-set version; custom rule configuration for application-specific threats; WAF alert and block logs; false-positive tuning records.

name_en: Private Connectivity for Sensitive Cloud Access (CST)
name_ar: الاتصال الخاص للوصول الحساس إلى السحابة — المستأجر
en: Private endpoint / PrivateLink configuration for storage and database services; ExpressRoute/Direct Connect circuit documentation; evidence that sensitive data services do not traverse the public internet; network flow logs confirming private routing.

name_ar: إعداد KMS السحابي وتسلسل المفاتيح
en: Cloud KMS key inventory (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / GCP Cloud KMS); key hierarchy documentation (master key, data encryption keys); key rotation schedule and evidence (annual minimum); access control policy for key management operations.

name_ar: إحضار مفاتيحك الخاصة (BYOK) للأحمال الحساسة — المستأجر
en: BYOK implementation documentation for Confidential/Restricted workloads; HSM-generated key material evidence; key import audit log; ability-to-revoke-key test evidence; key custody assignment.

name_en: Encryption of Data at Rest in Cloud Storage
name_ar: تشفير البيانات الساكنة في التخزين السحابي
en: Encryption-at-rest configuration for all cloud storage services (S3, Blob, GCS, RDS); CSP encryption report or configuration compliance scan; evidence AES-256 or equivalent algorithm in use; unencrypted bucket/container remediation log.

name_ar: إدارة الأسرار لأحمال العمل السحابية
en: Secrets management solution deployment (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault references); prohibition of hard-coded secrets in IaC/code (secret-scanning CI gate evidence); secret rotation policy and rotation audit log.

name_en: Cloud Management Plane Audit Logging (CloudTrail/Activity Log)
name_ar: تسجيل مستوى إدارة السحابة — CloudTrail / سجل النشاط
en: CloudTrail / Azure Activity Log / GCP Audit Log enabled in all regions/subscriptions; log retention configuration (minimum 1 year); log integrity validation enabled; evidence forwarding to centralised SIEM.

name_en: Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) Continuous Monitoring
name_ar: إدارة وضع الأمن السيبراني السحابي — المراقبة المستمرة
en: CSPM tool deployment evidence; coverage across all cloud accounts; daily/continuous scan schedule; critical/high findings SLA (e.g. P1 = 24 hours); monthly posture trend report.

name_en: SIEM Use Cases for Cloud Threat Detection
name_ar: حالات استخدام SIEM للكشف عن التهديدات السحابية
en: Cloud-specific SIEM use-case catalogue (root-account usage, S3 public-access enablement, security group open-all rule, suspicious API call volume, geographic anomaly); alert test records; mean-time-to-detect metrics.

name_ar: مراقبة سجلات تدفق شبكة VPC السحابية
en: VPC Flow Logs / NSG Flow Logs enabled for all production VPCs; retention policy; SIEM ingestion evidence; anomaly detection alert configuration for large outbound transfers or lateral movement patterns.

name_en: Cloud Workload & Container Security Monitoring (CSP & CST)
name_ar: مراقبة أمن أحمال العمل والحاويات السحابية
en: Cloud workload protection platform (CWPP) deployment coverage; container image scanning in CI/CD pipeline (policy-gate evidence); runtime threat detection alert logs; Kubernetes admission controller policy configuration.

name_ar: سياسة النسخ الاحتياطي للسحابة واختبار الاسترداد — المستأجر
en: Cloud backup policy specifying RPO/RTO per workload tier; automated backup configuration evidence; cross-region backup replication for Confidential/Restricted workloads; quarterly restore test records with pass/fail outcome.

name_en: Disaster Recovery Plan for Cloud Workloads
name_ar: خطة التعافي من الكوارث لأحمال العمل السحابية
en: Cloud DR plan document with failover architecture diagram; DR runbook per critical workload; annual DR test report with RTO/RPO achievement evidence; lessons-learned log.

name_ar: تصميم بنية التوافر العالي — مزود الخدمة
en: CSP SLA documentation; multi-AZ/multi-region deployment architecture for critical services; load balancer health-check configuration; auto-scaling policy; availability metrics report (monthly uptime vs. SLA).

name_ar: خطة الخروج من السحابة وقابلية نقل البيانات — المستأجر
en: Cloud exit plan document for each material CSP dependency; data export/portability assessment (standard formats, API availability); exit timeline and resource estimates; annual review; contractual portability clause evidence in cloud agreement.

name_ar: إدارة مخاطر الاعتماد على مورد واحد والسحابة المتعددة — المستأجر
en: Vendor lock-in risk register; architectural decision records for proprietary service use; mitigation strategies (abstraction layers, open standards, multi-cloud distribution); annual review of lock-in risk by cloud governance committee.

name_en: CSP Security Assurance Report Review (SOC 2 / ISO 27017)
name_ar: مراجعة تقارير ضمان أمن مزودي الخدمة — SOC 2 / ISO 27017
en: Current-year SOC 2 Type II report (or ISO 27001/ISO 27017 certificate) for each material CSP; management review record noting exceptions and CSP remediation commitments; tracking of bridge letters between annual report cycles.

name_ar: بنود الأمن السيبراني في عقود الخدمات السحابية — المستأجر
en: Cloud service agreement checklist covering: data residency, security incident notification SLA, audit right, data deletion on termination, sub-processor disclosure, law enforcement request notification; legal sign-off evidence.

name_ar: إدارة المخاطر لمعالجي البيانات الفرعيين من الطرف الرابع — المستأجر
en: CSP sub-processor disclosure list (extracted from cloud DPA/agreement); risk assessment for material sub-processors; change-notification clause evidence; escalation process for sub-processor changes affecting KSA data.

name_ar: اختبار الاختراق وإدارة الثغرات في السحابة — المستأجر
en: CSP penetration-testing authorisation obtained (cloud provider pen-test policy compliance); annual cloud workload penetration test report; critical/high finding remediation within SLA; cloud vulnerability scan coverage report from CSPM or scanner.

name_en: Cloud Security Configuration Baseline & IaC Policy-as-Code (CST)
name_ar: خط الأساس لإعدادات الأمن السحابي وسياسة الكود البنيوي — المستأجر
en: Cloud security baseline standard document (CIS benchmark alignment); IaC policy-as-code gate in CI/CD pipeline (OPA/Conftest/Checkov evidence); compliance scan results (% compliant vs. baseline); drift-detection alerts and remediation log.
